title: Real-Time State-of-Health Estimation and Online Degradation Prognosis from Partial Battery Discharge Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.14764v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the increasing integration of renewable energy sources, energy storage systems have become essential, making the accurate estimation of their State of Health (SOH) and degradation behavior critical. In this work, we propose a physics-informed deep learning approach for lithium-ion battery SOH prediction using incomplete discharge curves extracted from arbitrary voltage ranges, thereby reflecting realistic and heterogeneous operating conditions. The proposed method combines data-driven learning with physically motivated degradation dynamics to ensure consistent and reliable SOH estimation from partial discharge information, achieving a MAPE below 4$\%$. In addition, a real-time degradation trend estimation strategy is introduced to detect key aging transitions without requiring prior knowledge or historical data, making it applicable to a wide range of batteries. translated_title: 基于物理信息神经网络的部分电池放电实时健康状态估计与在线退化预测
translated_abstract: 摘要：随着可再生能源的日益普及，储能系统变得至关重要，因此准确估计其健康状态（SOH）和退化行为尤为关键。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于物理信息的深度学习方法，用于锂离子电池SOH预测，该方法利用从任意电压范围提取的不完整放电曲线，从而反映现实且异构的运行条件。所提出的方法将数据驱动学习与物理启发的退化动力学相结合，确保从部分放电信息中获得一致且可靠的SOH估计，平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）低于4%。此外，我们还引入了一种实时退化趋势估计策略，无需先验知识或历史数据即可检测关键的老化转变，使其适用于各种电池。总体而言，我们的方法能够从任意放电段实现SOH估计。
tldr: 本文提出一种物理信息神经网络方法，利用任意电压范围的部分放电曲线实时估计锂离子电池健康状态，误差低于4%，并无需历史数据即可在线检测退化趋势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-informed neural network approach that estimates lithium-ion battery state-of-health from partial discharge curves of arbitrary voltage ranges with under 4% error, and enables online degradation trend detection without historical data.
